family.selection: Every retained prime tile whose exact subgroup order n divides 10080.

bounds: For every compatibility-index-one pair, every choice of its two shifts intersects with exact density 1/(n_i n_j).
For r selected vertices, induced mandatory edges are bounded by the minimum of C(r,2), the total mandatory-edge count, and half the sum of the r largest full-graph degrees.
The maximum registered edge-to-excess ratio over r=2..33 bounds mandatory pair mass pointwise by that ratio times multiplicity excess.
method.stopping_rule: Run the frozen script once. Retain no_cover_selected_family only if the exact fixed mandatory-pair mass strictly exceeds the registered pointwise upper bound times density slack; otherwise retain no_conclusion. Any source, dependency, or execution error is an invalid run, not evidence.

nonclaims: A no-conclusion result is not evidence that the selected family can cover.
A bounded exclusion says nothing about tiles outside the n-divides-10080 family.
This method does not resolve Erdős problem 203 globally.
This producer analysis is not a Vela Verification or human Decision.
No scientific Standing changes from this experiment.
